newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Q2 real GDP rises 4.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech Q2 real GDP rises 4.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech second quarter gross domestic product (GDP), in real terms, rose 4.0 percent over the same period in 1995, the Czech Statistical Bureau said on Wednesday.
The CSU added that it had revised first quarter GDP growth upwards to 4.6 percent from a previously reported figure of 4.3 percent.
CZECH GDP Q2 96 Q1 96 H1 96 FY 95

Note. The CSU did not release a breakdown of figures for the second quarter or of its revisions to the first quarter. All figures are subject to revision. The first quarter figure is revised. The previously reported figure is in brackets. All results measure percentage change for period, year-on-year. All percentage changes are in real, inflation adjusted terms.

The CSU changed the methodology for calculating the inflation adjusted real amount in billions of crowns at the beginning of the year. The first quarter and first half 1996 figures use 1994 as a base, while the 1995 figures use 1989 as a base. The CSU has declined to release the real amounts for 1995 re-calculated using the new methodology.
